name: Sun sign as an ordinal 1-12 — older partner
explanation: Which sign the older partner's Sun occupied, Aries 1 to Pisces 12.

name: seasonal separation, cos harmonic 1
explanation: cos(1 x the two births' seasonal separation): the 1-per-year harmonic of Sun-to-Sun contact. h=1 peaks when the birthdays coincide, h=2 when they coincide OR are six months apart.

name: seasonal separation of the two births (0-182 days)
explanation: How far apart in the YEAR the two partners were born, ignoring which year. 0 means both born at the same point of the seasonal cycle. This is the Sun-to-Sun synastry contact and the sub-year part of the age gap at once.

name: sub-year remainder of the age gap (days)
explanation: What is left of the age gap after removing whole years: gap_days - 365.2425*round(gap_days/365.2425), folded to 0-182. This is the seasonal part of the gap and cannot carry a mortality effect, because mortality does not care which side of a birthday you fall on.

name: both Suns in the SAME sign
explanation: 1 when both partners share a Sun sign.

name: day of the year, cos harmonic 4 — younger partner
explanation: cos(4 x 2pi x day-of-year/365.25) for the younger partner: the 4-per-year component of the seasonal cycle, free of the 31-December-to-1-January wrap.

name: day of the year, cos harmonic 1 — older partner
explanation: cos(1 x 2pi x day-of-year/365.25) for the older partner: the 1-per-year component of the seasonal cycle, free of the 31-December-to-1-January wrap.

name: Chinese animal distance between the partners (0-6)
explanation: How many of the twelve animal years separate the partners' birth years, folded. Because it is the age gap modulo twelve, no smooth model of the gap can contain it.

name: born within 15 days of the same point in the year
explanation: 1 when the partners' birthdays fall within a fortnight of each other in the calendar, the strongest form of the 'same seasonal cohort' claim.

name: same stem element (Wood/Fire/Earth/Metal/Water)
explanation: 1 when both birth years carry the same of the five elements from the sexagenary stem.

name: liu-he secret-friend pair
explanation: 1 when the two animals form one of the six liu-he 'secret friend' pairs, held to be quietly supportive.

name: weekday of birth (0 Sunday .. 6 Saturday) — younger partner
explanation: Which day of the week the younger partner was born. The seven-day week is the oldest astrological cycle still in use and is almost perfectly orthogonal to both era and age gap.

name: born on a Saturn day (Saturday) — younger partner
explanation: 1 when the younger partner was born on Saturday, the day of Saturn — the classical significator of marriage, duty and endurance.

name: Suns in SQUARE (3 or 9 signs apart)
explanation: 1 when the Suns are three signs apart either way, the classically difficult aspect.

name: Suns in SEXTILE (2 or 10 signs apart)
explanation: 1 when the Suns are two signs apart, the classically easy aspect.

name: born on a Venus day (Friday) — younger partner
explanation: 1 when the younger partner was born on Friday, the day of Venus, planet of attraction and union.

name: born on a Saturn day (Saturday) — older partner
explanation: 1 when the older partner was born on Saturday, the day of Saturn — the classical significator of marriage, duty and endurance.

name: san-he trine group match (4 or 8 animals apart)
explanation: 1 when the two animals belong to the same san-he trine — the four groups of three that Chinese practice holds most compatible.

name: months between the two births in the year (0-6)
explanation: The folded distance between the two birth months, 0 to 6.

name: same Chinese animal (12 years apart, or born the same year)
explanation: 1 when both partners share an animal sign.

name: Suns in the same ELEMENT (trine — the classic 'compatible' rule)
explanation: 1 when the two Sun signs share an element (fire/earth/air/water), i.e. are 0, 4 or 8 signs apart. This is the single most repeated compatibility rule in popular astrology.

name: born on a Venus day (Friday) — older partner
explanation: 1 when the older partner was born on Friday, the day of Venus, planet of attraction and union.

name: both born on planetary days of the same sect (luminary/benefic vs malefic)
explanation: 1 when both birth weekdays are ruled by planets of the same classical sect: Sun, Moon, Jupiter and Venus on one side, Mars and Saturn on the other, Mercury neutral.

name: age gap in whole years (the NUISANCE, shown for scale)
explanation: The partners' age difference rounded to whole years. This is the term that carries the mortality effect, and it is listed here only so the periodic terms below can be read against it.

name: same weekday of birth
explanation: 1 when both partners were born on the same day of the week, i.e. their age gap is a whole number of weeks.

name: Suns in OPPOSITE signs (6 apart)
explanation: 1 when the Suns are exactly opposite, the axis read as both attraction and confrontation.

name: stem-element distance on the five-phase wheel (0-2)
explanation: The folded distance between the partners' stem elements on the five-phase cycle, where adjacency is generation and distance two is conquest.

name: age gap modulo the Metonic 19-year cycle
explanation: The age gap taken modulo the Metonic 19-year cycle and folded, isolating that cycle's own claim from the smooth age-gap trend. A smooth model of the gap cannot contain this.

name: popular 'compatible' verdict (same element OR sextile)
explanation: 1 when the pair satisfies the composite rule a magazine column would apply: same element, or two signs apart.

name: day of the year — older partner
explanation: The older partner's birth day counted from 1 January, 1-366. The season of birth, which every tradition here reads and which is very nearly orthogonal to the birth year.

name: seasonal separation, cos harmonic 2
explanation: cos(2 x the two births' seasonal separation): the 2-per-year harmonic of Sun-to-Sun contact. h=1 peaks when the birthdays coincide, h=2 when they coincide OR are six months apart.

name: Suns in the same MODALITY (cardinal/fixed/mutable)
explanation: 1 when the two Sun signs share a modality, i.e. are 0, 3, 6 or 9 signs apart — held to produce friction rather than ease.

name: liu-chong clash (exactly 6 animals apart)
explanation: 1 when the animals are directly opposed on the twelve-year wheel, the liu-chong clash — the specific and widely believed claim that a six-year age gap is unlucky for a couple.

name: Sun-sign distance between the partners (0-6)
explanation: How many of the twelve signs separate the two Suns, folded so 0 is the same sign and 6 is opposite. Every sun-sign compatibility rule in circulation is a function of this one number.

name: Sun in a fire sign — younger partner
explanation: 1 when the younger partner's Sun is in Aries, Leo or Sagittarius.

name: Sun in a fire sign — older partner
explanation: 1 when the older partner's Sun is in Aries, Leo or Sagittarius.
